title: NIP-42 AUTH and relay-unavailable handling across clients
intent: Browser, backend, operator, and FIPS-adjacent relay clients handle NIP-42 AUTH-required and unavailable relay outcomes consistently without polling or non-Nostr mutation fallback after relay acceptance.
scope: Browser relay subscription/query lifecycle treats AUTH-required relays without an AUTH event as excluded from the current operation and preserves relay metadata.
Backend relay pool/publisher records AUTH-unavailable metadata and configures NIP-42 private-key support when credentials are available.
Operator ContextVM client preserves OK rejection reasons and consumes CLOSED metadata during result waits.
FIPS subscriber/bridge record AUTH-unavailable metadata through existing event-driven CLOSED handling.
out_of_scope: NIP-86 relay administration and client-admin implementation files
REST or legacy mutation fallback after any relay accepts signed ContextVM traffic
